title: Pasta with tomato-based sauce and poultry, ready‑to‑heat

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with tomato sauce and chicken is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stove. The combination of tender chicken pieces, aromatic tomato sauce and al dente pasta provides a balanced flavor and a good amount of protein and carbohydrates for a complete lunch.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tomato sauce is often made from ripe tomatoes, olive oil, onion and spices, making it a rich source of lycopene.
Chicken is one of the most popular protein sources in ready meals because it cooks quickly and has a mild taste.
The pasta used is usually made from durum wheat, which gives a lower glycemic index compared with soft pasta.
The dish is commonly packaged in vacuum‑sealed or barrier films that preserve freshness and aroma until heating.
Microwave heating typically takes 3‑4 minutes, making it convenient for office lunches and travel.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Chicken provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Lycopene in tomato sauce
items.content: Lycopene is a powerful antioxidant that may support heart health and reduce the risk of certain cancers.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Durum wheat pasta releases energy slowly, helping to maintain satiety.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Tomatoes and chicken contain vitamins B6 and B12, important for metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: When prepared correctly, the dish contains modest amounts of saturated fat, fitting a moderate diet.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Ready meals often contain added salt; people monitoring blood pressure should watch portion size.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may be allergic to chicken and should avoid the product.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Food preservatives may be used to extend shelf life; sensitive individuals could experience reactions.

items.title: Thermal treatment
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave live bacteria; heat to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in a microwave (800 W) for 3‑4 minutes, stirring halfway through, or on the stovetop while stirring until hot. Serve immediately, optionally garnish with fresh basil, grated Parmesan or a drizzle of olive oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in the refrigerator at 0 °C to +4 °C. Once opened, consume within 2‑3 days. Do not freeze, as the sauce texture may change.
